lines.text: Rise, Ankhu.
lines.context: Spell 25 opening cinematic, shot 13. Spoken to Ankhu prostrate before him. First words he hears.

lines.text: Your voice has come back to you, Ankhu. Here, words are the only hands you have.
lines.context: The Cistern: introduction, line 1

lines.text: Water listens to a direction. Say flow, then west or east.
lines.context: The Cistern: introduction, line 2

lines.text: The gallery is above us. Watch what the water carries before you ask it to move.
lines.context: The Cistern: introduction, line 3

lines.text: The platform rides on the water. Where must the water go for it to come down to you?
lines.context: The Cistern: gentle hint after Ankhu fails (ElevatorNotHere)

lines.text: The ladder is rolled up above. There is another way to rise.
lines.context: The Cistern: gentle hint after Ankhu fails (LadderRaised)

lines.text: You stand between floors. Let the water choose your height.
lines.context: The Cistern: gentle hint after Ankhu fails (NoLandingAtThisHeight)

lines.text: That word has no power here yet. In this room only the water listens.
lines.context: The Cistern: gentle hint after Ankhu fails (NotYetTaught)

lines.text: You did not climb. You asked, and the water carried you.
lines.context: The Cistern: quiet approval when the room is solved

lines.text: The mirror floats on the western raft. The raft rises only when the water goes west, and then your platform sinks.
lines.context: The Held Step: introduction, line 1

lines.text: Some things must stay where they are after their support is gone. Say bind, then the thing you would hold.
lines.context: The Held Step: introduction, line 2

lines.text: Bring the mirror to the gallery, and leave nothing bound behind you.
lines.context: The Held Step: introduction, line 3

lines.text: That thread carries the whole platform now. Give its weight back to the water first.
lines.context: The Held Step: gentle hint after Ankhu fails (BindingBearsLoad)

lines.text: You can only hold the platform while you stand on it, high in the shaft.
lines.context: The Held Step: gentle hint after Ankhu fails (ElevatorNotReachable)

lines.text: The raft rises only with the water in the west. Can your platform stay high without the water?
lines.context: The Held Step: gentle hint after Ankhu fails (MirrorNotReachable)

lines.text: That word has no power here yet. Hold, release, and move the water.
lines.context: The Held Step: gentle hint after Ankhu fails (NotYetTaught)

lines.text: You held only as long as you needed to. Remember the feeling of letting go.
lines.context: The Held Step: quiet approval when the room is solved

lines.text: The far seal wants light. The near seal wants shadow. The gate ahead will ask for both at once.
lines.context: The Lingering Shadow: introduction, line 1

lines.text: The sleeper stands in the beam and casts the shadow. Wake him and he walks out of the light. His shadow follows him.
lines.context: The Lingering Shadow: introduction, line 2

lines.text: Unless you hold it first. And you still hold two threads from before. Your voice can carry no more than two.
lines.context: The Lingering Shadow: introduction, line 3

lines.text: That thread carries the platform. Give its weight to the water first.
lines.context: The Lingering Shadow: gentle hint after Ankhu fails (BindingBearsLoad)

lines.text: Your voice already holds two threads. Which one do you still need?
lines.context: The Lingering Shadow: gentle hint after Ankhu fails (BindingCapacityFull)

lines.text: There is no shadow to hold. Perhaps its owner should rest again.
lines.context: The Lingering Shadow: gentle hint after Ankhu fails (NoShadowToBind)

lines.text: That word has no power here yet. Hold, release, wake, sleep, and move the water.
lines.context: The Lingering Shadow: gentle hint after Ankhu fails (NotYetTaught)

lines.text: The shadow stays though its owner has gone. You will need this again.
lines.context: The Lingering Shadow: quiet approval when the room is solved
